description: This Java test class, CborJsonTest, is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.json.cbor package and contains unit tests verifying the serialization and deserialization of JSON objects and arrays to/from CBOR format. It uses JUnit for testing, AssertJ for assertions, and references classes related to JSON and CBOR data handling, focusing on correctness of encoding, decoding, and internal caching behaviors.

classes.name: CborJsonTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying CBOR serialization/deserialization of JSON objects and arrays, including internal cache behaviors.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the CborFactory instance before each test run.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonObjectNullWritesExpected
methods.description: Tests that serializing a null JSON object results in the expected CBOR hex string.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonArrayNullWritesExpected
methods.description: Tests that serializing a null JSON array results in the expected CBOR hex string.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonNullWritesExpected
methods.description: Tests that serializing a null literal produces the expected CBOR hex string.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonBooleanWritesExpected
methods.description: Tests serialization of boolean true and false values to specific CBOR hex strings.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonStringWritesExpectedSimple
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a simple string to its CBOR hex representation.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonStringWritesExpectedComplex
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a complex string containing special characters.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonIntWritesExpected
methods.description: Checks serialization of various integer values including max, min, and zero.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonLongWritesExpected
methods.description: Checks serialization of long integer values, including max, min, and specific values.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonDoubleWritesExpectedTestVectors
methods.description: Verifies serialization of doubles with special values like infinity, NaN, and precise values.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonObjectWritesExpectedEmpty
methods.description: Verifies serialization of an empty JsonObject.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonObjectWritesExpectedSimple
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a simple JSON object with known fields.

methods.name: validateImmutableJsonObjectInternalCachingBehaviour
methods.description: Checks internal cache states of JsonObject after various serialization/deserialization steps to ensure caching behaves as expected.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonArrayWritesExpectedForSimpleArray
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a simple JSON array to its CBOR hex string.

methods.name: writeImmutableJsonArrayWritesExpectedForMixedArray
methods.description: Verifies serialization of a complex JSON array with different value types.

methods.name: validateImmutableJsonArrayInternalCachingBehaviour
methods.description: Checks internal cache states of JsonArray after various serialization/deserialization steps.

methods.name: assertInternalCachesAreAsExpected (JsonObject variant)
methods.description: Uses reflection to verify internal cache states related to CBOR and JSON string representations within a JsonObject.

methods.name: assertInternalCachesAreAsExpected (JsonArray variant)
methods.description: Uses reflection to verify internal cache states related to CBOR and JSON string representations within a JsonArray.
